tasks.description: Extracts invoice line items from text dumps of invoices into a CSV file. Use when asked for a line-item CSV of the invoices in a folder.
tasks.intent: Extract invoice line items into a CSV with an amount check column.

tasks.description: Summarises invoice totals per vendor and per month from invoice text dumps. Use when asked for a totals summary of the invoices in a folder.
tasks.intent: Summarise invoice subtotals, tax and totals per vendor and month.

tasks.description: Checks invoice and statement text dumps for arithmetic, tax rate, duplicate and reconciliation anomalies. Use when asked for an anomaly report on invoices and vendor statements.
tasks.intent: Report anomalies in invoices and vendor statements.
